description: A React component named BubbleComponent that manages and displays linked items within a lexical editor context. It interacts with application state, linking controller, and rendering a LinkedItemBubble component, handling item activation, unlinking, and UI updates.

classes.name: BubbleComponent
classes.description: A React functional component that renders a bubble UI linked to an item, with capabilities to activate and unlink the item within an editor environment.

methods.name: BubbleComponent
methods.description: Main React functional component displaying a linked item bubble with event handlers for activation and unlinking.

methods.name: activateItemAndTogglePane
methods.description: Activates the item in the linking controller and toggles the associated application pane.

methods.name: unlinkPressed
methods.description: Unlinks the item from the selected item and removes the node from the editor.
